scope: Single whole-domain packed periodic-X symmetric-Y mode; no full-halo, other boundary policy or broad energy proof
range_constraints: mass-like W, PH, T, MU retain rows 0..m-1 columns 0..n-1 and copy x endpoint from x0 and y endpoint from y=m-1, including corner
U retains same core with two x aliases from columns 0,1 and final y row copied from y=m-1
V retains rows 0..m and columns 0..n-1 after symmetric normal wall zeroing; x endpoint copies x0 and extra y row negates y=m-1; y wall indices at physical ends are zero
weighted_projection_norm: For positive diagonal S and disjoint source-root alias groups, P=S^-1 Q S; for each retained root j and alias set I_j, ||I-P||_2 on its block is sqrt(1 + sum_i (S_j/S_i)^2); zeroed fixed outputs contribute identity norm 1. Take the maximum over nonempty groups and fixed outputs. Signs of copies do not affect this norm. No orthogonality of Q is assumed.
exact_conditional_algebra: If complete F output lies in range Q and is differentiable on considered path, (I-Q)G=(I-Q)K and (I-Q)A*v=(I-Q)v even when context depends on unprojected Y; P=S^-1QS is the corresponding scaled projector.
Observed Qp=p implies (I-Q)A*p=0, and complement of G+A*p equals (I-Q)K; zero requires independent QK=K evidence.
limitations: Projection and identities are exact-real algebra with source assumptions; floating-point evaluation and non-smooth/history-dependent callbacks require separate handling.
Actual selected JVP agreement, interior forcing, FD error and complete context are not bounded. Qp=0 error for one sample is not a universal constraint proof.
No runtime tests or model rerun; no changes made.
